description: Format capability matrix for PRPM converters - defines which subtypes each format supports and progressive disclosure fallbacks

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.notes: Cursor supports AGENTS.md files for project instructions. Custom slash commands in .cursor/commands/*.md (introduced v1.6, Sept 2025). Built-in /summarize command. Rules are appended automatically, slash commands are explicit prompts with more weight. No native agent/skill/plugin packages.

claude.name: Claude Code
claude.notes: Claude Code supports skills, agents, and plugins. Uses CLAUDE.md (not AGENTS.md) for project-specific instructions. Feature request open for AGENTS.md support (Issue #6235).

continue.name: Continue
continue.notes: Continue uses simple prompt files. No native support for advanced package types.

windsurf.name: Windsurf
windsurf.notes: Windsurf uses markdown rules with 12K character limit. No advanced package support.

copilot.name: GitHub Copilot
copilot.notes: GitHub Copilot coding agent supports AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, and .instructions.md custom instructions (as of August 2025). Full agents.md support.

kiro.name: Kiro AI
kiro.notes: Kiro supports agents in .kiro/agents/ directory. Full agents.md support.

gemini.name: Gemini CLI
gemini.notes: Gemini CLI uses extensions in gemini-extension.json. Custom slash commands in ~/.gemini/commands/ (user-scoped) or .gemini/commands/ (project-scoped). Built-in commands: /help, /copy, /mcp, /memory, /directory. Only supports GEMINI.md for project context. Does not support AGENT.md or AGENTS.md.

opencode.name: OpenCode
opencode.notes: OpenCode supports agents with mode/model/temperature config. Plugins are JavaScript/TypeScript modules in .opencode/plugin with 40+ event hooks. Slash commands available. Full agents.md support.

ruler.name: Ruler
ruler.notes: Ruler supports agents in .ruler/agents/ directory. Full agents.md support.

droid.name: Factory Droid
droid.notes: Factory Droid supports both skills and agents. Full agents.md support.

trae.name: Trae
trae.notes: Trae uses simple markdown rules. No advanced package support.

aider.name: Aider
aider.notes: Aider uses CONVENTIONS.md for coding standards. No advanced package support.

zencoder.name: Zencoder
zencoder.notes: Zencoder uses simple rules with glob patterns. No advanced package support.

replit.name: Replit Agent
replit.notes: Replit Agent supports AGENTS.md for custom agent instructions. Full agents.md support following the agent-rules.org standard.

zed.name: Zed
zed.notes: Zed supports .rules files (plain markdown, no frontmatter). Slash commands can be used in rules with /file, /diagnostics, /fetch, etc. Extensions written in Rust/WASM with extension.toml manifest. Also reads .cursorrules, .windsurfrules, .clinerules, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md in priority order. Extensions installed to ~/Library/Application Support/Zed/extensions (macOS). License required: MIT, Apache 2.0, BSD 3-Clause, or GPLv3.

agents.md.name: agents.md (Universal)
agents.md.notes: Universal agents.md format - works with OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, and most AI systems.

mcp.name: Model Context Protocol
mcp.notes: MCP is a server protocol, not a package format. Supports plugins via server configuration.

generic.name: Generic (Markdown)
generic.notes: Generic markdown format for maximum compatibility. Supports agents.md convention.

agentsMdSupport.description: Formats that intelligently support agents.md for progressive disclosure
agentsMdSupport.notes: These formats can use AGENTS.md as a universal fallback. Claude Code uses CLAUDE.md instead (not AGENTS.md). Gemini uses GEMINI.md instead. Cursor added AGENTS.md support in version 1.6+. GitHub Copilot added AGENTS.md support in August 2025. Zed reads AGENTS.md along with other rule file formats.
